rows.district_court_siddharthnagar: Reappointment of Retired District Court Employees
Head Assistant, Senior Assistant, Driver, Daftari, Process Server and Class IV Employee
Interview and Typing Test, where applicable

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply?
content_sections.text: The recruitment is intended for eligible employees who have retired from the District Court establishment and satisfy the conditions prescribed in the notification. Applicants must possess a satisfactory service record and must be physically fit to perform the duties associated with the post.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The engagement may continue until the selected person reaches 65 years of age . The actual engagement period will also depend on the date of joining and whether the vacancy is filled through regular recruitment or promotion.

content_sections.heading: Salary and Honorarium
content_sections.text: The selected retired employee will receive an honorarium calculated by deducting the pension amount from the last pay drawn for the corresponding post. Other admissible allowances will be paid according to the applicable and amended orders of the Uttar Pradesh Government.

content_sections.heading: Engagement Period
content_sections.text: The selected candidates will be engaged for the earliest of the following periods: One year from the date of assuming charge; Until the concerned vacancy is filled through direct recruitment or promotion; or Until the selected employee reaches 65 years of age.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process will include an interview for all advertised posts. Applicants for the Head Assistant and Senior Assistant posts will also have to appear in a Hindi typing test. The date of the interview and typing test will be announced separately. No travelling allowance will be paid to candidates attending the interview or typing test.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility and Service Record Conditions
content_sections.text: The applicant's character entries for the previous five years must be satisfactory. Selection will be based on the applicant's previous conduct and Annual Confidential Reports. No criminal or civil case should be pending or registered against the applicant. The applicant must be medically fit to perform the assigned duties. A candidate can apply for only one post.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Appointment
content_sections.text: The appointment will be completely temporary. The engagement may be terminated without prior notice if the selected employee's service is found unsatisfactory. The appointment does not create a right to permanent or regular employment. The engagement will end when the post is filled regularly, the contractual period ends or the candidate reaches the prescribed age limit.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Siddharthnagar District Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Obtain or download the prescribed application format attached to the recruitment notice. Select only one post for which you are eligible. Enter the required personal, retirement and service details. Attach the age proof and medical fitness certificate. Attach documents supporting the applicant's previous service and eligibility. Sign the declaration given in the application form. Submit the completed application to the Administrative Office of District Court Siddharthnagar. Ensure that the application reaches the office by 7 October 2026 before 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Application Submission Address
content_sections.text: Administrative Office, District Court Siddharthnagar, Uttar Pradesh

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Completed prescribed application form Recent passport-size photograph Proof of age Medical fitness certificate Retirement or previous service documents Last pay and pension details Service record or Annual Confidential Report details Identity and address proof Other supporting documents required in the application form

content_sections.heading: Details Required in the Application Form
content_sections.text: Name of the post applied for Applicant's full name Father's or husband's name Date of birth Permanent residential address Mobile number Email address Educational qualification Previous service details Pension and last-pay details Other information required by the selection committee

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only one application can be submitted by an applicant. Applications received after 5:00 PM on 7 October 2026 will not be considered. The prescribed application form must be used. Appointment will remain temporary and subject to satisfactory performance. Applicants must not have any pending or registered criminal or civil case. Selection will depend on the previous service record, character entries, interview and applicable skill test. Original documents may be required for verification during the selection process. No TA will be provided for attending the interview or typing test.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in Siddharthnagar District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 37 vacancies are available for Head Assistant, Senior Assistant, Driver, Daftari, Process Server and Class IV Employee posts.

faq.question: Q2. Who can apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Eligible retired District Court employees who satisfy the service record, age, medical fitness and other conditions can apply.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The completed application must reach the Administrative Office of District Court Siddharthnagar by 7 October 2026 before 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: All eligible applicants will undergo an interview. Candidates applying for Head Assistant and Senior Assistant posts will also have to take a Hindi typing test.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age for engagement?
faq.answer: The engagement can continue only until the selected employee reaches 65 years of age, subject to the other tenure conditions.
